protocol_status: frozen_before_candidate_source_or_test_content_access; no qualification result; no inference authorized
purpose: Qualify one metadata-selected, metadata-independent public Development candidate at source level using exact merge-base baseline, upstream-fixed source, and a frozen targeted wrong mutant before considering any model attempt.
qualification_gate: QUALIFIED_SOURCE_LEVEL only if the baseline, wrong-mutant, and upstream-fixed arms satisfy the exact frozen outcomes under identical test overlay, runner, sandbox, and budgets.
qualification_gates: After this protocol is committed and pushed, retrieve only the exact repository objects by frozen SHA; verify repository identity, merge-base ancestry, merge commit/head, license, and expected changed-path metadata.
Inspect only the source and changed test paths required to identify the PR-added regression; do not inspect any Held-Out task or evaluator.
Construct an independent trusted test overlay using only the candidate PR-added regression test(s) from the two metadata-listed test files. Do not edit their assertions.

Before any candidate test executes, freeze an execution addendum binding exact selected test IDs, test/support-file hashes, runner hash, arm source hashes, wrong-mutant diff hash, sandbox profile hash, commands, and environment.

The baseline uses source at exact merge_base_sha with the frozen test overlay. It must fail every targeted regression at the intended assertion with no import error, collection error, skip, timeout, or unrelated failure.

The wrong-mutant uses exact upstream-fixed source with only a predeclared incorrect relaxation/removal of the newly introduced rejection guard so at least one unsupported tool type is accepted. It must fail the same targeted regression at the intended assertion.
The upstream-fixed arm uses source at exact merge_commit_sha and the identical frozen test overlay; every targeted regression must pass with no skip or unrelated failure.
A source qualification passes only if all input hashes and identities match, all three arms meet their exact outcome gate, the grader boundary is validated, and resource/isolation limits hold.

run_order_and_limits.baseline_gate: Do not run wrong-mutant or fixed unless all baseline regressions fail at their intended assertions.
run_order_and_limits.mutant_gate: Do not run fixed unless all wrong-mutant regressions fail at their intended assertions.
run_order_and_limits.retry_rule: Any arm invocation consumes that arm. Stop on an unexpected result, timeout, import/collection error, resource breach, or isolation failure. Retry only under a new hash-bound addendum frozen before retry.

stop_rules: Do not fetch or inspect PR body, review comments, or unrelated patches.
Do not run the full vLLM test suite or any test outside the frozen addendum.
Do not continue if required tests need accelerator execution, network access, external services, or exceed resource limits.
Do not expose candidate prompt or source patch to any model or agent.
Keep qualification result separate from task split assignment and model capability.
Public pretraining exposure remains unknown even if the source-level qualification passes.
